visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with longish dark hair and a blue jacket holds a dark, patterned qipao dress. He has a shocked expression with his mouth wide open. The background is a clothing store with various hats on a top shelf and rows of garments on racks. (2) A woman with brown hair, wearing a patterned qipao, steps out from behind a sliding wooden door with curtains, smiling brightly at the camera. The setting is a clean, indoor fitting area. (3) The camera pans to a vanity area featuring a long wooden desk, large mirrors, and multiple warm-glowing Hollywood-style light bulbs. The background shows a window with a grid pattern and bright natural daylight. (4) Four individuals—two men and two women—are shown dressed in various traditional Chinese or vintage-style outfits. They are standing indoors surrounded by clothing racks and accessories. (5) A woman in a white fur shawl over her qipao smiles and gestures toward her attire. The lighting is soft and indoor. (6) Close-up of vintage accessories on wooden shelves, including fans with intricate floral embroidery and hats. (7) A man in a red robe and black hat poses against a dark blue wall adorned with vintage framed photographs. (8) A shelf displays multiple pairs of round, dark-lensed vintage sunglasses and two smoking pipes placed on stands. (9) A woman wearing a pink floral-patterned mask speaks to the camera in a room filled with clothing racks. (10) A man in a green traditional outfit and a flat cap sits by a large window, looking out while holding a teacup on a round wooden table. (11) A woman in a qipao and red hat plays with a wooden abacus on a counter in a room with orange walls. (12) The group poses for photographs in front of a wall of colorful paper lanterns and in various vintage-themed studio sets.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 male host, 1 male friend, 2 female friends, 1 shop assistant with mask, and 3 background customers/tourists.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main male host has medium-length wavy hair and wears a red traditional robe and black hat. One male friend wears a green outfit and a grey cap. Two female friends wear qipaos, one with a white fur shawl and the other with a red hat.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A multi-room vintage-themed space featuring clothing racks with qipaos and traditional attire, a brightly lit professional makeup vanity, an office with an abacus, a tea-drinking corner by a large window, and a wall of paper lanterns.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal male vocal shout marks the beginning, accompanied by upbeat, major-mode acoustic-pop BGM. Low-level shop ambience is present. (2) Energetic female vocals enter with rising intonation, expressing surprise and delight. Sound of a sliding door thud is audible. (3) Male narrator describes the environment with clear articulation and high speech rate. Upbeat guitar rhythm continues. (4) Multiple female and male voices overlap, characterized by laughter and high vocal arousal. Short percussive 'ding' SFX punctuates a scene transition. (5) Male vocal delivery shifts to a lower pitch and slower pace for a short poetic recitation, followed immediately by more high-tempo conversational speech. (6) Sound of clothing rustling as they show garments. (7) Multiple voices interact in a questioning and answering format. BGM maintains a consistent energetic pulse. (8) Rapid-fire editing cuts with corresponding whoosh SFX lead into the final group closing, where the male lead's voice is dominant and authoritative yet friendly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Shop Tour -> Interactive Experience -> Feature Highlights -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a specific location in Taiwan where tourists can rent qipaos and traditional costumes for free. It showcases the high quality of the clothing, the professional makeup facilities, and the various retro-themed photo-taking spots to attract visitors interested in photography and cultural experiences.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly highlights the 'free' aspect of the service and provides a clear call to action for viewers to visit and share with friends.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-energy social media vlog with fast-paced editing and colorful visual text, effectively utilizing a 'free' hook to engage the audience.
